scope: Twelve image-operation readbacks from five packaged material states and 36 shader-literal lookup readbacks from a sixth. The compute wrapper uses original image operations, SRV/sampler slots and three original PC-relative base calculations. Image tags and literal results are checked independently.

cases.374: Volume sample at (2,6,2) fetched all four channels.
cases.2129: Each cube face sampled column 5, row 2. Face 0 through 5 selected six different subresources.
cases.4364: Explicit gradients selected mip 0 at (5,2), mip 1 at (2,1) and mip 2 at (1,0).
cases.1671: Integer image load at (3,5), channel W, returned 12372.
cases.363: Executed the complete material block at 43704 with indices 0 through 35. Each case computes three PC-relative addresses, reads the index table, scales the selected entry, and loads two coordinate components. The last load overwrites its own address register. Every result matched the original packaged 32-word table across two 18-index cycles.

limits: The wrapper isolates the material image instruction and its emitted resource declaration. Full material shading and retail scene output require separate measurements.
